description: Shared Renovate preset for jasonmx repos. Kept identical to github>hebehomes/dev//renovate/default. Public on purpose: the hosted Renovate app cannot read a preset in a private repo it isn't installed on.

customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in workflow inputs, marked `# renovate: datasource=<d> depName=<n>` on the line above.

packageRules.description: github-actions: minor and major bumps in one PR, for review.

github-actions: digest and patch bumps in one PR, merged once CI is green. A separate group, so a minor bump never holds it back. Repos with no status checks never automerge (ignoreTests stays false).
